Summarize the guidance and case law findings, noting any recent developments that shift the risk calculus
Save the summary to the matter's iManage workspace with the research date noted

testing.expected: A dated summary of current agency guidance and case law exists before advice is finalized

checklistGeneric: Confirm the termination checklist is completed before the action proceeds
Confirm severance terms, if any, are reviewed against the standard separation template
checklistSpecific: Review the proposed disciplinary action or termination against the department's termination checklist
Confirm documented performance or conduct history supports the proposed action
Review any proposed severance arrangement against the standard separation agreement template for required releases and consideration
Record the legal review outcome (Approved/Approved with Conditions/Not Approved) on the matter record

testing.expected: Proposed disciplinary and separation actions show a completed termination checklist and documented review outcome

checklistGeneric: Confirm the review covers the current published version of the policy
Confirm identified compliance gaps are documented with a recommended fix
checklistSpecific: Pull the current published version of the workplace policy from OpenText Document Management
Review each policy section against applicable federal and state employment law requirements
Document any compliance gap found, with the specific statutory requirement and a recommended policy edit
Record the review outcome and recommended edits in the matter record

testing.expected: Workplace policies show a documented legal compliance review with any gaps and recommended edits recorded

checklistGeneric: Confirm the needs assessment is informed by the matter volume/trends data
Confirm the assessment covers every business unit, not only frequent requestors
checklistSpecific: Pull the trailing-12-month advisory matter volume by subject area and business unit from Power BI
Identify business units with a high volume of routine questions in a specific subject area as training candidates
Survey business unit leaders for self-identified training gaps
Compile the findings into a training needs assessment memo for General Counsel review

testing.location: Advisory matter volume by business unit report
testing.expected: A training needs assessment referencing matter volume data is produced annually

checklistGeneric: Confirm the survey is sent to every attendee, not a sample
Confirm results are compiled before the curriculum refinement step
checklistSpecific: Send the standard post-training effectiveness survey to all session attendees within 2 business days of the session
Include questions on content relevance, clarity, and confidence applying the material
Compile the survey results into a summary scorecard by session
Attach the scorecard to the training record for use in curriculum refinement

testing.expected: Post-training survey results are compiled into a scorecard for every delivered session

checklistGeneric: Confirm attendance is tracked for every session
Confirm session materials match the approved curriculum
checklistSpecific: Deliver the scheduled legal awareness training session using the approved curriculum materials
Track attendance via the sign-in sheet or the learning platform's attendance log
Record any live questions raised for potential inclusion as a future recurring-question theme
Confirm the session recording (if applicable) is uploaded for employees who could not attend live

testing.expected: Attendance is tracked and recorded for every delivered legal awareness training session

checklistGeneric: Confirm content is reviewed by a second counsel before finalization
Confirm content reflects the business units' identified training needs
checklistSpecific: Draft the training content (slides, scenarios, quiz questions) addressing the identified needs assessment topics
Include at least one ABC Insurance-specific scenario per topic to ground the material in real practice
Route the draft content to a second counsel for accuracy and clarity review
Finalize and save the approved content to the Legal Training library in Confluence

testing.expected: Training content is reviewed by a second counsel before being finalized in the training library

checklistGeneric: Confirm the curriculum covers each priority topic identified by General Counsel
Confirm the curriculum is approved before content development begins
checklistSpecific: Confirm the priority topic list with General Counsel (e.g. contract principles, antitrust, privacy, ethics)
Structure the curriculum into modules with defined learning objectives per priority topic
Sequence modules by audience (all-employee vs. manager-level vs. high-risk-function)
Publish the approved curriculum outline to Confluence for content development to follow

testing.expected: An approved curriculum outline exists covering each identified priority topic before content development

checklistGeneric: Confirm the briefing covers regulatory and case law developments from the completed quarter only
Confirm attendance from each business unit leadership team is tracked
checklistSpecific: Compile the quarter's significant regulatory and case law developments relevant to ABC Insurance's business
Prepare a briefing deck summarizing each development and its practical implication for business units
Deliver the briefing to business unit leadership and track attendance
Distribute the briefing deck afterward via email and post it to the legal intranet

testing.location: Quarterly legal update briefing deck and attendance record
testing.expected: Quarterly briefings are held and documented with a deck and business unit leadership attendance

checklistGeneric: Confirm each intranet page shows a current-as-of date
Confirm broken links or outdated templates are corrected promptly
checklistSpecific: Review the legal intranet's policy, template, and guidance pages on a monthly cadence for currency
Update or archive any page referencing a superseded policy, template, or regulatory position
Confirm all document links resolve correctly and templates open in the expected format
Log the review date and any updates made on the intranet's maintenance log

testing.expected: The legal intranet shows a monthly review with a maintenance log entry and no broken links or superseded content

checklistGeneric: Confirm the embedded support arrangement is documented with a defined scope and cadence
Confirm the business unit's satisfaction with the arrangement is periodically checked
checklistSpecific: Identify high-activity business units based on advisory matter volume from the trends analysis
Establish a recurring office-hours or standing-meeting cadence with the identified business unit
Document the embedded support scope (topics covered, escalation path) in a support charter
Log embedded support hours provided against the matter management system for capacity tracking

testing.expected: High-activity business units have a documented embedded support charter and logged support hours

checklistGeneric: Confirm guidance notes avoid legal jargon and are reviewed for plain-language clarity
Confirm each note is dated and tied to a specific frequently-encountered issue
checklistSpecific: Select a frequently encountered legal issue from the recurring-questions analysis
Draft a one-to-two-page plain-language guidance note explaining the issue and the compliant approach
Have a second counsel review the note for both legal accuracy and plain-language clarity
Publish the approved note to the Legal Guidance Notes page in Confluence with a publication date

testing.expected: Plain-language guidance notes are published with a review sign-off and publication date

checklistGeneric: Confirm refinements are traceable to specific survey feedback items
Confirm the curriculum version is updated with a new date after refinement
checklistSpecific: Review the compiled post-training survey scorecards for low-scoring content areas
Identify specific curriculum modules requiring revision based on the feedback themes
Update the affected module content and note the feedback-driven change in the version history
Publish the refined curriculum with an updated version date to the Legal Training library

testing.expected: Curriculum revisions reference specific survey feedback and are published with an updated version date

checklistGeneric: Confirm the response is sent within the published SLA window for the matter's urgency tier
Confirm the response is logged on the matter record with the response timestamp
checklistSpecific: Check the matter record's SLA due date/time based on its urgency tier
Draft and send the response to the routine legal question within the SLA window
Log the response timestamp in the matter record's 'SLA Response' field
Flag any matter approaching or breaching SLA for supervisor visibility on the queue dashboard

testing.expected: Routine legal question responses are logged with a timestamp within the published SLA window

checklistGeneric: Confirm training completion figures reconcile against the learning platform's attendance records
Confirm counsel support coverage metrics reference the embedded support log
checklistSpecific: Pull training completion rates by business unit from the learning platform attendance records
Pull counsel support coverage hours from the embedded support log in the matter management system
Compile both metrics into the Power BI legal training and coverage dashboard
Report the dashboard figures to General Counsel as part of the quarterly legal operations review

testing.expected: Training completion rates and counsel support coverage metrics are tracked and reported quarterly
